_sources.listing: Google Business Profile, read in the user's own Chrome via Claude in Chrome (2026-11-26): 'Paul Mulholland Carpentry', 4.9 stars, 7 reviews, category 'Carpenter', phone +61 405 567 578, closes 5 PM, service-area business (no street address), no website ('Add website' shown).
_sources.serviceArea: Google service-area outline (headless render, same day): central Wagga Wagga and North Wagga Wagga, from the Murrumbidgee River down to Turvey Park.
_sources.services: Google reviews: a built-in wardrobe (Donna Graham, 4 stars), reviewing and doing repairs from a pre-purchase building inspection report (Nisha Mathew), work set up to suit an elderly owner (Geoff Simpson). The listing cover photo shows a timber deck and ramp beside a stone wall. Review chips: helpful staff 3, genuine advice 2. Services kept to these.
_sources.brand: No website, socials or logo found. Sampled from their own Google listing cover photo (reddish timber deck and ramp, grey stone wall, terracotta pots): sample-brand suggested #8b6758 / #61514a / #eaded8; set by eye to timber primary #8f5437 (white 6.02:1), stone dark #262321, terracotta accent #e0995c (6.60:1 on dark). Not an official brand; confirm with the owner.
_sources.reviews: Google Reviews tab, same session, 'More' expanded: 6 five-star, 1 four-star. Three complete 5-star reviews copied verbatim (Nisha Mathew, Geoff Simpson, Janki Amin); Kabi Maharjan's ends in '…' so was skipped.

gap: No website: the Google listing shows 'Add website', so people who find Paul can only ring during work hours; there's nowhere to send a building report or photos and ask for a quote.

realReviews.author: Nisha Mathew
realReviews.text: Paul was quick to respond to my request and helped review the repairs I needed to do per the building inspection report, in the pre-purchase phase of a property. I recommend Paul's expertise to anyone looking for carpentry related assistance, he is very friendly and professional in his advice.

realReviews.author: Geoff Simpson
realReviews.text: Paul has just done work for my elderly Mum. He is very professional, friendly, helpful and made it work best for mum. He delivered exactly what she wanted. He is approachable and sincere ( made the job easy). The work is immaculate. Thanks mate.

realReviews.author: Janki Amin
realReviews.text: Paul was very helpful and genuine with about his advise and work!

finalCta.headline: Got a carpentry job or repair list?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send photos, a description or your building report through the form, or give Paul a ring. He'll look at the job and send a written quote.
Wagga Wagga, including North Wagga and Turvey Park. Just outside? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Can you help with a building inspection report?
faq.a: Yes. Paul can go through the carpentry items on a pre-purchase report with you, explain what they mean and quote the repairs.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
